items.event_title: Google signs 3.59-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
items.news_summary: Google contracted for 3,590 MW of electricity from Constellation, including 890 MW tied to upgraded nuclear plants, supporting more than $4.3 billion of new investment as AI data centers intensify power demand.
items.investor_materiality: Very high: one of the largest U.S. tech power-procurement agreements and a direct read-through for AI data-center electricity constraints, nuclear generation and CEG.

items.event_title: Chevron CEO warns oil and fuel supply buffers are thinning
items.news_summary: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth said global oil and refined-product supply buffers are thinning amid the Middle East conflict, with physical oil landed in Asia approaching $150 per barrel even as Brent futures trade materially lower.
items.investor_materiality: High macro and energy relevance because a sustained physical-market squeeze can affect inflation, Fed policy, airlines, transports and energy equities.
items.selection_reason: Fresh CEO warning with a striking physical-versus-futures price gap and broad market implications.
